name: Halls of Syston fruit-and-veg corner
observations: Red-brick two-storey corner mass with shallow pitched roof and repeated light-framed rectangular upper windows.
Green shop fascia and projecting green canopy/awning run along ground-floor bays.
Fruit/vegetable boxes and displays occupy the pavement in front of glazing.
End gable/brick return faces the brook-side opening; do not extend a continuous terrace across the watercourse.
Wide bridge/side-road views provide context beyond the shop face; signage partly blocked by delivery van.
Delivery van wording helps identify the business but is not a measured shop sign source.
unknowns: Exact dimensions, rear elevation and interior layout are not established. Street View address is a camera label, not this unit address.
review_basis: All listed captures reviewed in contact sheets; selected originals also inspected at native resolution. Notes describe visible appearance, not surveyed construction.
placement_confidence: Approximate frontage marker derived from camera route, side and estimated offset; not a measured footprint.

map_position.method: Estimated offset from photographed camera route; B050 uses Google place pin. Not measured building geometry.
